prompts.video.idea.detailed: Suggest 6 ideas for a [seconds]-second video on “[topic]” for [audience]. I'm filming on [what I film with]. For each: format (how-to, story, before-and-after, Q&A), what happens in the first 3 seconds, what the viewer takes away, filming difficulty 1–3.
prompts.video.idea.refine: I like idea [number]. Make it work without people on camera.
prompts.video.idea.check: Sum up my idea in one sentence: [idea]. Is it clear why anyone would watch?
prompts.video.script.short: Write a script outline for a [seconds]-second video: [idea]
prompts.video.script.detailed: Write a script outline. Idea: [idea]. Length: [seconds] seconds. Table: time, what's on screen, what's heard (voice or sound), on-screen text. Open with a problem or question, middle with the substance, end with a takeaway or action. Mark facts “check” if you're unsure.
prompts.video.script.refine: Cut the voice-over by a third without losing the meaning.
prompts.video.script.check: If watched without sound, does the video make sense? What should I add as on-screen text?
prompts.video.storyboard.short: Make a storyboard from the script: [script]
prompts.video.storyboard.detailed: Turn the script into a storyboard table. For each shot: number, duration, framing (wide, medium, close-up), angle, what happens, camera movement, sound, transition to the next. Bear in mind I'm filming on [what I film with] without a helper. Script: [script]
prompts.video.storyboard.refine: Group the shots by location so filming goes faster.
prompts.video.storyboard.check: Which shots are missing for smooth editing?
prompts.video.hook.short: Suggest 5 honest openings for a video: [what it's about]
prompts.video.hook.detailed: Video: [what it's about]. Suggest 6 options for the first 3 seconds: a question, a surprising detail, showing the result first, a mistake everyone makes, a quick action, “did you know” (only with a checkable fact). No exaggeration or promises the video doesn't keep.
prompts.video.hook.refine: Option [number] sounds too loud. Make it calmer.
prompts.video.hook.check: My hook: [text]. Does the video deliver on that promise?
prompts.video.scenes.detailed: Here's the story for the video: [story]. Break it into 4–7 scenes. For each: location, who's on screen, what happens, what has changed by the end of the scene, duration. Mark the climax. Characters should be fictional or real people who've agreed.
prompts.video.scenes.refine: Scene [number] drags. How can I show the same thing faster?
prompts.video.scenes.check: Here's a quick run-through of the scenes: [summary]. Is there a gap in the logic?
prompts.video.shots.detailed: Make a shot list for this scene: [scene]. For each: subject, framing, angle, whether a tripod or stabiliser is needed, number of takes. Add 3 cutaways (details, hands, objects) that will help in the edit. Mark the shots that can't be skipped.
prompts.video.shots.refine: I only have [time] to film. Which shots are essential?
prompts.video.shots.check: I've filmed: [what's filmed]. Is it enough for the edit?
prompts.video.subtitles.short: Split the text into 1–2 line subtitles: [text]
prompts.video.subtitles.detailed: Turn the voice-over into subtitles. Rules: no more than 2 lines of 40 characters, break by meaning without splitting phrases, no hard-to-read abbreviations. Mark places where sounds or music should be captioned for deaf viewers. Text: [text]
prompts.video.subtitles.refine: Make a [language] version of the subtitles, marking where the translation needs checking.
prompts.video.subtitles.check: Can a viewer read these subtitles if each is shown for [seconds] seconds?
prompts.video.length.short: Cut the script from [seconds] to [new length] seconds: [script]
prompts.video.length.detailed: The script runs [seconds] seconds but needs to be [new length]. Suggest what to cut, combine or speed up. Keep the opening, main point and ending. Show the new script and separately a list of what was removed so I can restore something. Script: [script]
prompts.video.length.refine: Make another 15-second version as a teaser.
prompts.video.length.check: Was anything lost in the cut that the video doesn't make sense without?
prompts.video.edit.short: Make an editing plan from the footage: [footage]
prompts.video.edit.detailed: Footage: [footage]. Script: [script]. Make an editing plan: order of shots, where to cut, where to use cutaways, where on-screen text goes, where music dips or rises, transitions. Suggest how to make a quick rough cut first and then refine.
prompts.video.edit.refine: The video feels slow. Where can I tighten the edit?
prompts.video.edit.check: Here's my rough cut by timecode: [description]. What feels off?
prompts.video.respect.short: Check the script for anything offensive or stereotyped: [script]
prompts.video.respect.detailed: Check the script before publishing: stereotypes about groups, jokes at someone's expense, recognisable people without consent, dangerous actions viewers might copy, someone else's music or footage without rights. For each issue: why it's a risk and how to fix it. Script: [script]
prompts.video.respect.refine: How can I keep the humour in scene [number] without mocking anyone?
prompts.video.respect.check: What description and label should I add if the video contains AI-generated footage?

verify.video.idea: Check you can actually film the idea with what you have, without infringing anyone's rights.
verify.video.script: Read the script aloud with a stopwatch: that shows whether it fits the time.
verify.video.storyboard: Check the storyboard on location: light and space may not allow the shot you planned.
verify.video.hook: A hook must honestly promise what's in the video. Clickbait damages trust.
verify.video.scenes: Make sure each scene has a job: if it can be cut without loss, cut it.
verify.video.shots: Film each shot with 2–3 seconds to spare before and after: you'll need it in the edit.
verify.video.subtitles: Check the subtitles against the recording: automatic recognition mixes up names, terms and numbers.
verify.video.length: After cutting, rewatch the whole video: sometimes a link between parts disappears with the excess.
verify.video.edit: Take music and sounds from libraries with a clear licence and check the terms of use.
verify.video.respect: If people appear in the video, get their consent to publish. For children, get their parents' consent.
